light.best.quote: Set your poinsettia in a bright location so that it receives at least 6 hours of bright, indirect sunlight each day.

light.min.quote: receives at least 6 hours of bright, indirect sunlight each day

light.directSun.quote: Putting it in direct sunlight may fade the color of the bracts.

temperature.minC.quote: Chilling injury is also a problem and can cause premature leaf drop if the temperature drops below 50 °F.

temperature.idealC.quote: The plant grows best in part shade at temperatures of 65 to 70 degrees Fahrenheit.

humidity.quote: Do not put your poinsettia near drafts, excessive heat or dry air from appliances

humidity.reason: 乾いた空気を避けるよう勧めるため「ふつう」とした

watering.growing.quote: Water the plant when the soil surface feels dry, but do not overwater.
Never let the potting mixture completely dry out

watering.winter.quote: Water them thoroughly when the soil surface feels dry to the touch.

tips.ja: 暑すぎても葉が黄色くなって落ちる。昼も21℃（70°F）を超えないように。
tips.quote: The daytime temperature should not exceed 70 °F.

tips.ja: 10℃（50°F）を下回ると冷えて葉が落ちる。
tips.quote: Several factors can cause premature leaf drop, such as temperatures dropping below 50 °F, poor light or poor nutrition.

tips.ja: 次の冬に色づかせるには、9月下旬から毎日16時間の真っ暗な時間が必要。
tips.quote: Starting in late September, the plant will need 16 hours of uninterrupted darkness

tips.ja: 花（苞）が咲いている間は肥料を与えない。
tips.quote: Do not fertilize a poinsettia when it is in bloom.

tips.ja: Clemson Extension は「毒性は強くないが、食べると腹痛・下痢・嘔吐の可能性、樹液でかぶれることがある」としている。
tips.quote: consumption of foliage may lead to stomachache, diarrhea or vomiting

note: 冬の鉢花。NC State は猫・犬などに害ありとし、Clemson は「強い毒性はない」とする（どちらの記載も表示）。
